card.line: Ramoth-gilead was a city of refuge east of the Jordan, in Gad's land, and later a battleground between Israel and Aram where kings fell and a king was anointed.

moments.title: A city of refuge
moments.text: The LORD told Israel to set apart cities where someone who killed by accident could flee. Ramoth in Gilead, from the tribe of Gad, was one of them.

moments.title: Ahab wants the city back
moments.text: King Ahab said Ramoth-gilead belonged to Israel but Aram still held it. He asked Jehoshaphat of Judah to fight with him to take it.

moments.title: Prophets say go to war
moments.text: About four hundred prophets told the king to go up to Ramoth-gilead and win. Micaiah first said the same, then told what the LORD had shown him: Ahab would fall there.

moments.title: Ahab dies in battle
moments.text: The kings went up to Ramoth-gilead. Ahab disguised himself, but an arrow struck him and he died that evening, as the LORD had said.

moments.title: Jehu anointed king
moments.text: Elisha sent a young prophet to Ramoth-gilead with a flask of oil. He anointed Jehu king over Israel, and the army commanders then proclaimed, "Jehu is king!"
